description:
FILED s530c (Opus agent, 2026-10-31).  Newly EXPOSED by #3854's fix (YAML-PP-v0.39.0 t/54.glob.t used to stop in subtest `valid`; it now passes that subtest, 4/4 inner rows, and stops right after it).  Not narrowed yet.

    tools/run-dist-t.pl ~/.cpan/build/YAML-PP-v0.39.0-0 t/54.glob.t
  perl 5.40.3: ok 1 - valid / ok 2 - ioscalar / ok 3 - error / 1..3
  PCL (s530c): ok 1 - valid, then dies: Can't locate object method "descend" via package "main" at - line 1.
`descend` is Test::Deep's comparison method (Test::Deep::Cmp subclasses; `Test::Deep::descend($got, $exp)` calls `$exp->descend($got)` on a Test::Deep object).  The next code after subtest `valid` is subtest `ioscalar`: `IO::File->new("< $Bin/54.glob.t")`, `$yp->dump_string($fh)`, `like $dump, qr{--- !perl/glob:IO::File}` -- no cmp_deeply there, so the die is either a Test::Deep call from the END of subtest `valid` (its loop runs cmp_deeply per object) or a `like` routed into Test::Deep.  "via package main" says the invocant was the STRING "main" (or an unblessed value stringifying so).  The run also prints three #2610 detector lines for Test/Deep/Cache/Simple.pm `weaken` (lines 30, 45, 46) -- a candidate: Test::Deep::Cache::Simple's weaken parsed as a list call.
ROWS: YAML-PP-v0.39.0-0 54.glob.t *PLAN* (re-attributed from #3854 by s530c).
subject: YAML-PP t/54.glob.t dies after subtest `valid`: Can't locate object method "descend" via package "main" (Test::Deep) -- newly exposed by #3854, not narrowed
